s01.shot: fallen star academy at night, a small cowardly servant boy entering a grand starry hall among proud robed students

s02.shot: extreme close-up of a tired amber eye snapping open in shock, messy brown hair visible

s03.shot: the servant boy polishing boots in a grand academy corridor, shoe brushes and rags, ignored by passing students

s04.shot: star summoning night ceremony in a celestial courtyard, elders calling down golden stars, the boy peeking from behind a stone wall

s05.shot: an obsidian star with black-violet corona descending from a torn sky toward the stunned boy, dark smoke trailing

s06.shot: the boy's hand reaching up to touch the floating black star, a spark of purple light at his fingertips

s07.shot: darkness engulfing the boy as a horrified crowd screams, the celestial courtyard flooding with black smoke

s08.shot: morning: the boy walking out of black smoke unharmed, a living black star glowing in his right eye

s09.shot: the furious boy with a glowing star-eye as the tallest sky tower's light dies from top to bottom, debris floating

s10.shot: terrified academy masters around a round table, the eyepatched grandmaster standing, dread and panic

s11.shot: night council in a dark chamber, robed elders raising hands to vote, a full red moon through a tall window

s12.shot: the boy standing on a rooftop at night listening, faint smile, star-eye glowing on the right side of his face
